messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: undesirable traceplot
parts:
In bugs example vol1/equiv, I had difficulty matching 
results from Stan to those from JAGS, so I look at the 
traceplots.  The traceplots for two variance parameters 
are not good.  After running a longer chain (20000), 
I have the ``correct'' estimates now. 

The first two pages of plots are for samples from Stan
while the last two are for JAGS. 

I am not sure it is worth looking, but report this before 
I forgot again. 

--
Jiqiang

I'm glad the traceplot was bad before it converged
and that running it longer got to the right answers.
They ran a lot of the BUGS examples for a long time.

We can look into what's giving the algorithm a hard
time.
